name: Palawan
about: Dry season Nov–May (best Jan–Apr) is calm and clear, monsoon Jun–Oct brings storms and rougher seas.
overview: Limestone cliffs, hidden lagoons, and some of the clearest water in the Philippines — regularly ranked among the world's best islands.
costOverview: Palawan stays affordable even with its world-class scenery — a full day of island-hopping with lunch costs less than a single meal at a nice restaurant back home, and the Underground River tour remains one of the best-value bucket-list activities anywhere.
